args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
==========================

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight details)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required at some beaches)
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)
- Hat and sunglasses (for sun protection)
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Insect repellent
- Light sweater or jacket (for cooler evenings)
- Formal attire (if planning any nice dinners)

Don't forget to check airline baggage restrictions before packing!
